sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can consolidate the honfoglalás story: why the Magyar tribes left the steppe, how they crossed the Carpathians, who led them, how they settled the basin, and why 895 still matters today.
I can name Árpád, the seven tribes, and the vérszerződés as central to the traditional account of the honfoglalás.
I can use miután and mielőtt to sequence cause and effect in a historical narrative.
I can review this unit's vocabulary and grammar (miután/mielőtt, named and collective multi-subject narration).
